description: This file defines the ThreadPool class and related nested classes and interfaces for managing a thread pool, including job scheduling, execution, and monitoring within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes definitions for jobs, schedulers, dispatchers, and worker threads, along with mechanisms for job resubmission, scheduling, and monitoring, with optional warning reporting features.

classes.name: ThreadPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of worker threads, job scheduling, and execution, with support for monitoring and callbacks.

classes.name: ThreadPool::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback to notify when the thread pool is idle.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IJob
classes.description: Interface representing a job that can be resubmitted.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IScheduler
classes.description: Interface for scheduling jobs at specific times.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for initializing, deinitializing, and dispatching jobs.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Metadata
classes.description: Structure containing information about a worker thread's current state.

classes.name: ThreadPool::DispatchedJobMetaData
classes.description: Metadata for monitoring dispatched jobs, including worker ID, call sign, dispatch time, and report count.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IDispatchedJobMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring dispatched jobs, allowing insertion and removal of job metadata.

classes.name: ThreadPool::JobType
classes.description: Template class representing a job with states and associated worker logic.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Minion
classes.description: Represents a worker entity that processes jobs from the queue.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Executor
classes.description: A thread wrapper that runs a Minion and manages its lifecycle.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a job request, dispatching it via the dispatcher, and optionally reporting warnings.

methods.name: Resubmit
methods.description: Resubmits a job for execution, possibly returning a new dispatch object.

methods.name: Idle
methods.description: Callback invoked when the thread pool becomes idle.

methods.name: SaveDispatchedJobContext
methods.description: Stores metadata about dispatched jobs for monitoring.

methods.name: RemoveDispatchedJobContext
methods.description: Removes monitoring metadata for dispatched jobs.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Marks a job as completed, updating internal state and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Main loop for a worker thread to process jobs from the queue.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a job to the thread pool for execution.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Attempts to revoke a job from the queue or currently executing jobs.

methods.name: RevokeRequired
methods.description: Checks if a job needs to be revoked.

methods.name: Idle
methods.description: Checks if the thread pool is idle and triggers callback if so.

methods.name: Closure
methods.description: Handles rescheduling or immediate posting of jobs after completion.
